summary_md: **LLMnEder ([@LLMnEder](https://x.com/LLMnEder/status/2116081939929342293))** summarizes the *DynaRev* preprint ([arXiv 2610.40133](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40133)), which revises web-agent goals mid-task across 181 tasks and five models and finds even agents that acknowledge the change often miss the new constraint by the end.

referenced_urls.title: DynaRev: Benchmarking Web Agents under Dynamic Goal Revision

relevance: Benchmarks a real failure mode: honoring mid-task instruction changes.
